name: chain
description: The chain module (shruggr/skein#78): the one writer of the instance's chain state — headers, transactions, proofs, spends, settlement, broadcasts — under chain/state; everyone else reads it by CID. Box chain: {fn: ingest | status | proof, args} from anyone, and the host's events (header from its feeds, proof from its broadcaster); box status: the status provider's messages (optional: left out on a host with none). Ingest a BEEF: proven, answered at once; unproven, recorded, broadcast, and answered on each state change (accepted, proven, rejected). docs/CHAIN.md.
